parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>  If your instance has an ID, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the request fails. If no Overview page exists or no instance ID is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

For more information, see the [Overview](~~356505~~) topic of IoT instances.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the gateway product to which the devices belong.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot batch-import-device --iot-instance-id iot-1n8t0000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-list DeviceSecret=b4d43f700000010ba5e5 Sn=QC4000000001 DeviceName=device1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot BatchImportDevice --region cn-hangzhou --DeviceList.1.DeviceName device1 --IotInstanceId 'iot-1n8t0000' --DeviceList.1.DeviceSecret b4d43f700000010ba5e5 --DeviceList.1.Sn QC4000000001 --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
